IDEA000031.title: A contrast marker selects between explicitly opposed alternatives

design.contrast: explicit alternative pair with candidate versus matched paired fields without candidate
design.falsifier: No held alternative-structure contrast, or alternatives are not mutually exclusive under a blinded coding rule, falsifies the contrast mechanism.
design.mechanism: The candidate introduces or scopes an opposition whose two alternatives remain separately typed.
design.prediction: Candidate contexts show higher rates of mutually exclusive alternative structures and polarity reversal across the two fields; a generic connector predicts no alternative interaction.
design.related: Not negative-context exclusion, polarity retuning, or simple adjacency counting; alternatives must be predeclared
design.scope: cached paired fields only; endpoint availability_unknown for independent opposition coding
design.unit: candidate occurrences with two bounded alternative fields in the same record

IDEA000032.title: A coordination marker scopes over a multi-item list

design.contrast: candidate-bearing multi-item list versus matched adjacent item sequences without shared-predicate structure
design.falsifier: No held shared-predicate contrast, or list grouping depends on a single segmentation choice, falsifies the coordination mechanism.
design.mechanism: The candidate contributes coordination scope over a bounded list and leaves each item independently typed.
design.prediction: Candidate contexts show repeated shared-predicate/list structures and fewer independent predicate assignments; an item-noun model predicts no scope shift.
design.related: Distinct from amount frames, part cooccurrence, and role-position interaction; no quantity meaning is assumed
design.scope: cached bounded fields; endpoint availability_unknown for independent list-scope annotation
design.unit: candidate occurrences with two or more independently typed neighboring items and a shared predicate

decisions.reason: The integrated review correctly preserves the explicit mutually-exclusive alternative restriction. The remaining valid objection is narrower: the generic-connector rival is asserted to predict no alternative interaction, but a generic connector can occur between independently opposed alternatives. That is a rival-null/model specification problem, not a correction that broadens the proposal to scalar or corrective contrast.
decisions.accepted_correction: Freeze the generic-connector null and its expected interaction after matching content/discourse; do not define the candidate/control contrast by the outcome. Treat failure of the exclusive branch as failure of this predeclared variant only.

decisions.reason: The integrated review correctly keeps the design restricted to shared-predicate multi-item lists; clause-coordination examples must not be used against it. The remaining valid objection is that an item-noun model can also occur in a shared-predicate list, so “no scope shift” does not follow from that rival without a frozen parse and explicit rival prediction. Segmentation dependence is a measurement stop, not a semantic refutation.
decisions.accepted_correction: Freeze the parse or alternatives before outcome selection, and define a candidate-dependent scope/position prediction that the item-noun rival cannot also satisfy.

overall: No material scope misrepresentation remains in the integrated review after excluding the prior out-of-scope scalar/clausal examples. Both remain untested method designs with missing independent annotation; no semantic evidence or readiness follows.
